items.source:
#[must_use]
pub fn rejected_until(limits: &UnifiedLimits, now: u64) -> Option<u64> {
    limits
        .rejected()
        .filter_map(|window| window.reset_unix)
        .filter(|reset| *reset > now)
        .max()
        .map(|reset| reset.min(now.saturating_add(MAX_VENDOR_COOLDOWN.as_secs())))
}
